subject: Logs & Observability: contract renewals and retention options
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@datadog.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming Datadog renewal + log retention options

Hi Markus —

Quick heads up: your current Datadog contract for logs and APM is up for renewal on 2026-04-15. I attached the preliminary quote showing two paths:

- Keep 30 days hot retention (current baseline) + add 90 days cold archival (cost: +18% YoY)
- Move to 14 days hot + 180 days low-cost archival with index pruning (cost: +6% YoY but 24% lower query spend)

Attachments: Datadog_quote_Q2.pdf

I can schedule a short call this week to walk the team through indexing knobs and log exclusion rules that typically drop billable volume by 20-40% for customers of your size. Let me know what time works.

Best,
Samir
Enterprise Sales — Datadog
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@datadog.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming Datadog renewal + log retention options

Samir —

Thanks for the note and the quote. Can you also include an estimated tokenized query cost delta? Our finance team wants both ingestion and query breakdowns.

Internal: Monica/Laura/Rishi — we need to triage this across three vendors (Datadog, Grafana, Sentry). Priorities:

1) Cut predictable ingestion spend (index rules / drop noisy hosts)
2) Keep 30d for infra traces, but explore 14d for app logs with longer cold storage for compliance
3) Get procurement-friendly contract language (no auto-escalation beyond CPI; defined escalation paths)

Monica — can you pull last 12 months of bill by tag and attach? Laura — loop finance if we need PO thresholds. Rishi — want your ops take on the risk if we reduce hot retention for app logs.

Available: Thu 11:30-12:30 or Fri 09:00-10:00 PT for a vendor call.

Thanks,
Markus
VP, Platform Engineering — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming Datadog renewal + log retention options

Adding the billing export and a quick breakdown (see attachment Retention_costs_breakdown.xlsx). Highlights:

- Average daily ingested GB (last 90d): 5.4 TB/day
- Top 3 noisy sources (50% of bill): CI runners, debug-level app logs from staging, legacy mobile sdk logs
- Query spend has spiked 30% month-over-month driven by ad-hoc analytics on logs

Recommendation: short-term gating: implement index exclusion for staging and CI; set ingestion filters on legacy mobile SDK. That should immediately drop billable volume ~28%. Medium-term: evaluate 14d hot + archive for non-security logs.

Attachments: Retention_costs_breakdown.xlsx

-Monica
Senior Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@grafana.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Grafana Cloud: retention tiers + migration incentives

Hi Laura / Markus —

Following up from our outreach: Grafana Cloud can offer 90 days hot for logs with tiered cold storage at a lower cost than the default archival. I've attached a short doc with the retention tier pricing and a one-time migration credit if you consolidate query dashboards onto Grafana metrics pipelines.

Key notes:
- Migration credit applies if you sign before 2026-04-20
- We can set up a trial of indexless long-term storage (searchable via on-demand rehydrate)

Attachments: Grafana_retention_options.pdf

Happy to join the joint vendor call to compare options across providers.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Strategic Accounts — Grafana Labs
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@grafana.com>, Samir Gupta <samir@datadog.com>, Jordan Price <jordan@sentry.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Logs & Observability: contract renewals and retention options

Team —

Let's consolidate: vendor call Friday 2026-03-13 09:00 PT (30m). Agenda: current usage, two retention configurations (cost & risk), migration credits, and contract terms (auto-escalation, SLAs, audit logs).

Before the call:
- Vendors: please bring ingestion + query cost deltas and a sample contract redline for procurement review.
- Monica: please share the per-tag bill by midnight PST (thanks).
- Rishi: prep a short risk note on moving app logs to 14d hot (bullet points OK).
- Laura/Procurement: please confirm if PO thresholds > $100k require VP sign-off.

If any vendor cannot make the slot, propose an alternate. I want to keep this short and decision-focused.

-Markus
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Logs & Observability: contract renewals and retention options

Confirmed — procurement: PO thresholds: > $75k requires Director sign-off; > $250k requires CFO approval per policy. I'll start a short SOW checklist and upload to the Drive link below.

Drive (docs + redlines): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-ExampleDriveLink
